## Context

Ticket aimless-seclusive-tigershark cites ADR 0018 as authority for plan review before claim. ADR 0018 governs the T5c trust-boundary scope gate and does not establish claim enforcement. Ticket messy-moose-jig and `docs/plan-review-gate.md` are the correct sources for that behavior. The original ticket record and GitHub metadata must remain unchanged.

## Plan

- Append a correction comment to aimless-seclusive-tigershark.
- Identify ADR 0018 as the wrong citation for claim enforcement.
- Cite messy-moose-jig and `docs/plan-review-gate.md` as the governing historical and current sources.
- Verify the correction by reading the target ticket after the write.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] aimless-seclusive-tigershark contains an append-only correction.
- [x] The correction cites messy-moose-jig for the historical claim-enforcement decision.
- [x] The correction cites `docs/plan-review-gate.md` for current behavior.
- [x] The original description remains unchanged.
- [x] No repository file or GitHub metadata changes.
